title: A Head-Level Investigative Study of Self-Supervised Backbones for Synthetic Speech Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.34426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) speech backbones are the standard frontend for synthetic-speech detection, and layer-wise probing has established which layers carry the most signal. But analysis stops there: which of a layer's twelve attention heads compute the spoof decision is unknown. We present the first head-level study of two frozen backbones, WavLM-base and Wav2Vec2-base, on ASVspoof 5. Per-head ablation shows that only a few heads carry the decision while others actively oppose it; removing those heads lowers equal error rate (EER) with no retraining, by 13% relative in WavLM and 22% in Wav2Vec2. We also find a probe-free signature: spoofed speech draws more focused attention than genuine speech, and this gap alone separates the two almost as well as the full representation, peaking at each backbone's most discriminative layer. translated_title: 面向合成语音检测的自监督骨干网络的头部级研究
translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）语音骨干网络是合成语音检测的标准前端，逐层探测分析已经确定了哪些层携带最多的信号。但分析止步于此：一层中的十二个注意力头中究竟是哪些在计算欺骗决策仍是未知的。我们在 ASVspoof 5 数据集上首次对两个冻结的骨干网络 WavLM-base 和 Wav2Vec2-base 进行了头部级研究。逐头消融实验表明，只有少数注意力头携带决策信息，而其他头部则主动对抗该决策；移除这些头部无需重新训练即可降低等错误率（EER），在 WavLM 中相对降低 13%，在 Wav2Vec2 中相对降低 22%。我们还发现了一种无需探测器的特征：伪造语音比真实语音的注意力更加集中，仅凭这一差距就能几乎与完整表示一样好地区分真假语音，且在每个骨干网络最具判别力的层上达到峰值。最后，攻击身份可以从每个头部中被解码出来，但各头部之间的差异在于它们执行的功能，而不在于它们感知的内容。
tldr: 该研究首次对自监督语音骨干网络进行注意力头级别分析，发现仅少数注意力头主导合成语音检测决策，移除对抗性头部无需重新训练即可将等错误率相对降低 13%–22%，且伪造语音与真实语音之间的注意力集中度差异本身即可几乎替代完整表示实现真假语音区分。
en_tdlr: This first head-level study of SSL speech backbones shows that only a few attention heads drive synthetic speech detection while others oppose it—removing those heads cuts EER by up to 22% without retraining—and the attention-focus gap between spoofed and genuine speech alone nearly matches the discriminability of the full representation.
